paragraphs.text: Duck is making bread in her little kitchen. She is mixing flour and water. The bread smells very good.
paragraphs.translation: 鸭子正在她的小厨房里做面包。她正在搅拌面粉和水。面包闻起来香极了。

paragraphs.text: Rabbit comes to the door. "Can I help you?" she asks. Duck is very happy. Rabbit is cutting sweet apples.
paragraphs.translation: 兔子来到门口。“我来帮你，好吗？”她问。鸭子特别开心。兔子正在切甜甜的苹果。

paragraphs.text: Bear is carrying a big basket. He is picking more apples from the tree. "I like eating warm bread," he says.
paragraphs.translation: 熊提着一个大篮子。他正在从树上摘更多的苹果。“我喜欢吃热乎乎的面包。”他说。

paragraphs.text: Now the three friends are working together. Duck is putting the bread in the oven. Bear is washing the plates.
paragraphs.translation: 现在三个朋友一起忙活。鸭子把面包放进烤箱。熊在洗盘子。

paragraphs.text: Soon the bread is ready. It is warm and sweet. They are eating and singing together.
paragraphs.translation: 很快面包就做好了。它又热又甜。他们一起吃着、唱着。

paragraphs.text: "Good friends make good bread," says Duck. Everyone is smiling. The little kitchen is full of love.
paragraphs.translation: “好朋友才能做出好面包。”鸭子说。每个人都笑着。小小的厨房里满满都是爱。

quiz.sentenceWithBlank: Duck ___ making bread in her little kitchen.
quiz.audioText: Duck is making bread in her little kitchen.
